description: Fires when played is the engine's top choice in a losing position (cp_loss >= 100 but played_is_best). The player picked the best damage-control move available.

fact_glossary.mover_is_user: true if the player who picked the move is the user

variants.user: {played_san} — only move. Best you've got in this position.
variants.opp: {played_san}. Opponent had no better move here.
